historicalDate.original: переход от Великого княжества Московского к Русскому царству в 1547 г.; без отдельного территориального изменения

baseStates.notes: The coverage-period change in 1547 is a polity/title transition, not a separately evidenced external-border mutation. Therefore the final verified Grand Moscow geometry is carried into the Russian Tsardom as the opening base state. It is bounded through 1551-12, immediately before the Kazan territorial change represented separately from 1552 onward.
